environment.description: IoT message ingestion service running on EC2 instance behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough. No application-layer filtering. Service exposed on port 8443 with mTLS disabled for legacy device compatibility. SQLite database at /var/iot/devices.db contains device registry with firmware keys and provisioning secrets.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no inspection
config.database: SQLite with device secrets, firmware signing keys
